frictions.description: agent-browser surfaced only a terse runtime error ('global is not defined') with no stack trace in `errors` output, making root-cause localization slower.
frictions.resolution: Captured both `errors` and `console` JSON outputs and added supplemental API checks so assertion intent could still be partially evidenced while marking UI assertions blocked.

blockers.description: Frontend UI did not render in agent-browser for /, /dashboard, and /transactions. Page stayed blank and console error repeatedly reported: 'global is not defined'.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retried reloads, switched headless/headed mode, navigated directly to routes, and attempted temporary in-session network shim; runtime error persisted and UI remained blank.

summary: Attempted all 10 assigned search/filter assertions via agent-browser, but all are blocked by frontend runtime failure (`global is not defined`) causing blank UI. Supplemental API checks with scoped data prefix UTV-SRCH-A-20260323141945 returned expected 200 responses and correct filter semantics, but UI contract verification remains blocked.
